items.title: Zelensky says Ukraine needs $115 billion in Western support for 2027
items.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine would need $115 billion in Western assistance in 2027 and could require a similar amount in 2028. He warned that elections in some EU countries could bring governments less willing to support Kyiv.

items.title: Poland detains two Ukrainians over nationalist graffiti on war memorials
items.summary: Two Ukrainian nationals were reportedly detained in Poznań after slogans praising the Ukrainian Insurgent Army were painted on three Polish war memorials. Polish prosecutors are examining possible Russian intelligence involvement; that suspicion is not an established finding.

items.title: EU reportedly wary of Russian oil shipping ban in next sanctions package
items.summary: Bloomberg was cited as reporting that the European Commission may omit a proposed ban on maritime transport of Russian oil from its 22nd sanctions package, fearing opposition from member states. The report said a similar dispute forced changes to the previous package.

items.title: Reports describe Russian missile launches and strikes in southern Ukraine
items.summary: Reports described five Iskander-M ballistic missiles launched from Crimea toward targets in Odesa and Mykolaiv regions, alongside the start of a broader Russian missile-and-drone attack. The reports did not provide a confirmed damage or casualty assessment.
